summary: Changed the DX11 one-click selector so gameplay remains DirectGpuOnly=true while DisableDesktopDuplication=false keeps the PresentationTheater/menu mono capture source alive. The existing directTransportOnly gameplay path still rejects classic SBS frames, so ACK/run-identity failures cannot be hidden by a classic gameplay fallback.
